name: auria-garage
description: Your AURIA Garage in ChatGPT and Codex: ask what your car needs, what it has cost and how far you drive it, and log service, fuel, mileage, issues, diagnostic codes and reminders by describing them.

interface.longDescription:
AURIA Garage keeps a car's whole maintenance life in one place: service history, reminders, issues, parts and mods, fuel, mileage and diagnostic codes. This plugin brings it into ChatGPT.

Ask plain questions and get answers from your own records: what is due or overdue on a car, worked out from its current mileage and today's date; what the car has cost this year, by service type, part category and month; how far you drive and what fuel costs you; whether a check-engine code has come back; or the full timeline of a car's history.

Log work the way you would describe it. Say "I had the oil changed at the dealer at 84,200 miles" and ChatGPT adds the service record and the odometer reading. Log fill-ups by spending, quantity, tank level or range, record a scanner's codes, open an issue when something sounds wrong and resolve it when it is fixed, or set a reminder for the next service.

You stay in control. You approve exactly what ChatGPT may do on AURIA's own consent screen, and you can disconnect it at any time from your Garage profile. Every entry it adds is permanently labelled as written by an AI assistant. It cannot delete anything: it adds new entries, and the only change it makes to an existing one is marking an issue resolved. Approvals last 30 days, and changing your password, signing out of all devices or changing how you sign in disconnects it within 15 minutes.

To use it you need an AURIA account with at least one vehicle in your Garage.
defaultPrompt: What maintenance is due on my car?
What has my car cost me this year?
Log a fill-up: 11.2 gallons at 84,650 miles

positive.prompt: What cars are in my AURIA Garage?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the vehicles on the test account by name. The test account has one car, a 2022 Honda Civic.

positive.prompt: What maintenance is due on my Civic?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reminders that are due or overdue, worked out from the car's current mileage and today's date.

positive.prompt: What has my Civic cost me this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives this year's totals by service type and month, and notes any records without a cost.

positive.prompt: I just filled up the Civic: 11.2 gallons for 41.30 dollars at 84,650 miles.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds one fuel fill-up with that volume, cost and odometer reading. It appears in the Garage labelled as written by an AI assistant.

positive.prompt: My check engine light is on and the scanner says P0301. Log it on the Civic.
positive.expected_behavior: Records the reading on the car's diagnostic codes, labelled as written by an AI assistant. If other codes are still active on the car, it first asks whether the scanner still shows them.

negative.prompt: Delete the last service record on my Civic.
Book me a service appointment at a shop.

review.commerce_description: AURIA Garage does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.
